title: ScriptOutput
description: Output from the Scriptwriter Agent: a beat-split video script ready for the Producer to render.

body.description: Full body narration text (may duplicate suggested_visual_beats narration for reference).

estimated_duration.description: Estimated total video duration in seconds.

claims_used.description: Claims from ResearchOutput that are used in the script.

claims_not_used.description: Claims from ResearchOutput that were excluded from the script.

narration_text.description: The narration text for this specific beat (used to generate per-beat audio).

beat_type.description: Type of visual component to use for this beat.

image_url.description: Optional image URL for beats that use KenBurnsImage.

suggested_visual_beats.description: Ordered list of visual beats. Each beat gets its own narration audio — this is load-bearing for Phase 1's per-beat audio generation.
